applyTo: "frontend/**"

# Frontend Implementation Instructions

- Use TypeScript-safe patterns and avoid implicit any.
- Keep API URLs configurable through Vite environment variables.
- Never leave mocked diagnosis logic in production-facing components.
- Prefer explicit error and retry messaging for failed API calls.
- Keep visual design and copy suitable for healthcare-adjacent workflows.
- Ensure responsive behavior across desktop and mobile widths.
- For UI behavior changes, include build validation evidence in PR notes.
